defect.text: the report field `head` is 045cfec - the HEAD at generation time - while the artifact is committed at f2fe9a0. No reviewedAtHead / headAtCommit pair disambiguates the two, so a reader quoting `head` alone gets a hash that does not contain the artifact. Same class of defect as r6t7's stale `head`.

items.question: is it genuinely independent, or a copy of t1?
items.verdict: 成立 (implementation independent; evidentiary independence limited - and it says so itself)

evidence.noImport: grep over the file: no import of r7t1, no require of it, no child_process, no spawn. The only reference is readFileSync of docs/evidence/current/r7t1-bridgefree-main-verify.json (L25/L83/L89), guarded by existsSync, used only to fill the comparison table.
evidence.differentSources: t1 parses docs/evidence/current/t31-dataset.json (21 components, no componentType). t2 parses main-snapshot-r3t2.json (63 components, has `type`) plus main-restore-verify.json (42 removedOriginal ids, page table). Different files, different blobs - not a re-read of the same artifact.
evidence.differentUnit: t2's unit is one component row / one wire record with explicit `type`; t1's unit is a page-export component without any type field. Confirmed by reading both: real difference in the data model, not just in wording.
evidence.differentDedup: t2 dedupes by exact component id and by exact wire id|net, with a separate 42-ID removal set. t1 has no removal set.

deeperFinding.claim: the 21 agreement is not a second measurement
deeperFinding.why: main-restore-verify.json already asserts components: 21 itself, and it is also the source of the 42 removedOriginal ids. So 63 - 42 = 21 re-derives the number that the same record already states, from the pre-restore state of the same page. The two artifacts are before and after of one restore operation, not two independent captures.
deeperFinding.whoSaysIt: t2 states it in path.limitation: 'this is a different artifact and implementation, not an independent capture. The snapshot is the 63-component pre-restore state, so current 21 is derived by subtracting the recorded 42 IDs.'
deeperFinding.weight: independent as code and as derivation path; NOT independent as evidence about the live canvas. It upgrades 21 from 'member self-report' to 'recomputed from committed records', which is real but weaker than a second bridge read. It must not be counted as a second measurement of the canvas.

defect.text: path.differentFromT1[0] says t1 'is planned as a page-source parser'. t1 is not a page-source parser: no .epro2/.esch exists in the repo, and r7t1 parses a committed page *export* (t31-dataset.json). The distinction matters, because it is the reason t1 has no componentType. Mischaracterizes the other task; does not affect t2's own numbers.

items.question: stride 4 for wires; netflag by componentType (+3V3 is a part); stride 2 or attr-name counting would be an automatic fail
items.verdict: 成立 (with a scope correction on the stride item)

evidence.netflag: counted via `component.type` (L58-L59: byType.set(component.type, ...)), i.e. the same basis as componentType, not by id or name. I verified the trap is genuinely avoided rather than accidentally passing: in main-snapshot-r3t2.json the component {id: 'layout:flag:_3V3:bus:240', type: 'part', name: '+3V3'} exists, survives the 42-ID removal, and is counted among the 8 parts.
evidence.removalSet: I re-derived the split myself: the snapshot has 63 components; all 42 removedOriginal ids are type=netflag, so 55-42 = 13 netflags and the 8 parts are untouched. current = 21, byType = {part: 8, netflag: 13}. No id or name heuristics involved.
evidence.stride: NOT APPLICABLE, not wrong: the script never parses `Line` and never segments a wire; the wire invariant is `snap.wires.length` = 55 records. It therefore cannot commit the stride-2 error (69 segments / 5 phantom diagonals), but it also does not independently corroborate the 62-segment figure that r7t1 reports.
evidence.noNameBasedCounting: grep confirms no /MCU|GND|3V3/ style classifier anywhere in the file.

items.question: six items item-by-item against r7t1, no averaging

table.status: PASS (r7t1 value is a reconstruction; r7t2 measures it directly)
NOT COMPARABLE - different objects; no average taken

evidence.recompute: I re-ran t2's script myself: computed {devices: 21, part: 8, netflag: 13, wires: 55, netNamePairs: 55, pages: 2, hexIds: 0}, mismatches [], exit 0.
evidence.crossCheck: t2's report records differences: [{key: 'pages', t1: 18, ours: 2}] and nothing else; its t1Sha256 33dcdb06... matches my r7t1 artifact's actual sha256 byte for byte, so it read the committed t1 rather than an older draft.
evidence.noAveraging: pagesNote states 'The two numbers describe different objects; no average or rounding is used. Neither offline path proves the live page count.' I confirm no averaged or blended page value appears anywhere in the report.

items.caveatOnPages: all three page numbers in play are 2026-10-21 snapshots of a volatile object: t31 records 18 page records at 13:51, main-restore-verify records a 2-entry page table at 06:06 with a *different* P1 uuid (d224f8d1...) than t31's P1 (03feee84...). Page ids re-register, so neither number is usable as 'current'. t53's 2 is a --pages default, not a measurement.

items.question: the 101-devices note: verifiable arithmetic, or unresolved without guessing?

evidence.noSourceOnDisk: I ran my own scan: `101` appears in 5 files under docs/evidence/current/*.json and in no markdown. Every occurrence is a line number (r9t1:101, L101), an attribute id (attr101), a coordinate (y 1014.8 / h: 101), or a hash fragment (...d101cf...). No component/device total of 101 exists anywhere.
evidence.t2Behavior: status: 'unresolved', explanation: 'Not derivable from these sources. I do not guess whether it included another page or a library; a page/library table with 101 rows is missing.' No estimated or substituted number.
evidence.arithmeticOffered: 63 snapshot components - 42 removedOriginal = 21, and all 42 ids are present in the snapshot (the script hard-fails otherwise, and it exits 0). The arithmetic it does offer is checkable and I checked it.

defect.text: its checked[0] enumerates the scan hits as 'only line/h values'; the set also includes attr101 and hash fragments. The conclusion (no component/device total) still holds - I verified it - but the enumeration is incomplete.

items.question: self-proof: freshness, packages 0, wrote=0, t53 real exit code

evidence.freshness: I ran it myself: `node docs/evidence/review/shared/freshness.mjs --check` -> {"status":"FRESH","strictLib":false,"baselineVersion":4,"packages":5,"files":21,"configs":8,"tsconfigs":7}, exit 0. Matches the value recorded in t2's selfProof.freshness.
evidence.packages: git diff --name-only 045cfec..HEAD -- packages is empty; f2fe9a0 adds exactly 2 files, both under docs/evidence.
evidence.writes: grep for .save|.modify|.create|.delete|.clear calls and writeFileSync/appendFileSync/createWriteStream/child_process/spawn/exec/execSync/fetch -> NO_MATCHES. Imports are node:fs (readFileSync, existsSync), node:crypto, node:url, node:path.
evidence.t53: I ran it myself rather than trusting the record: exit 2, '[t53] CANNOT JUDGE (BRIDGE_UNREACHABLE) ... [t53] no invariant was evaluated; this is exit 2, not a pass'. t2's report carries exitCode: 2, isPass: false and the same raw stdout, so it did not launder t53 into a pass.
evidence.wrote: 0; sourceStable true (it hashes its two inputs; the blobs I read are the ones at HEAD)

defects.text: `head` = 045cfec is the generation-time HEAD, not the commit f2fe9a0 that contains the artifact; no reviewedAtHead/headAtCommit pair.
path.differentFromT1[0] describes t1 as a 'page-source parser'; t1 parses a committed page export, because no page source exists in the repo.
old101.checked[0] says the 101 scan found 'only line/h values'; attr101 and hash fragments are also present. Conclusion unaffected.

overall.why: the implementation is genuinely independent (different sources, different unit, different dedup, no import of t1), the two historical traps are avoided for real rather than by luck - netflag by `type` with +3V3 verified as a part among the 8, and no stride-2 segmentation at all - all six comparable numbers reproduce, pages is reported as a different object without averaging, 101 is left unresolved without guessing, and t53 is carried as exit 2 / isPass false. The three defects are narrative-level and do not move a number.
overall.scopeWarning: sound here means 'internally sound and honestly scoped', not 'independent confirmation of the canvas'. Both t1 and t2 derive from 2026-10-21 bridge snapshots of the same MAIN page; t2 reconstructs 21 from the pre-restore snapshot and the restore's own removal list. The live canvas is still unverified in this session because t53 has never returned 0.
